summary: Frontend-only targeted retest (iteration 126). Every /api/** request was answered by a Playwright fixture (/app/tests/frontend_iter126_fixture.py): a fake session in the script only, all GETs mocked, and every non-GET (solution-open, visit, answers PUT) fulfilled locally. There was no real login, no DB writes, no AI calls and no live backend writes. Tested at 1920x800 and 390x844, in light and dark. THE ITERATION 125 CSS ROOT CAUSES ARE FIXED, verified with real computed styles. (1) Outcome filters: font is 12px on desktop and 11px on mobile, radius 10px. Each filter has its own accent: incorrect red #B92B45, correct green #087B68, skipped and marked amber #9E550A, dropped and bonus slate. The active filter is solid accent with white text (checked for incorrect, correct and skipped). (2) Exam destinations: mocks blue, chapters amber, results cyan, and the active link is solid. In dark mode the inactive links get dark tints. (3) The shared Radix tabs use data-tab-value and show different colours despite the preview wrappers. Results tabs: analysis blue, progress amber, accuracy green, rank cyan, solutions red. Series tabs and My Tests tabs: progress amber, saved amber, completed green. (4) NavigationCard data-nav-tone gives blue, green and red cards on the ExamHub and the chapter subject chooser, with matching border and icon background. NEW RESULTS URL CASES PASS. (a) ?subject=Physics&question=q60 now opens Mathematics Q60, and the URL is rewritten to subject=Mathematics. (b) filter=weird is rewritten to filter=all. (c) Score-version buttons keep the user in Solutions: we went from My Tests to Results, then Solutions, Mathematics, Incorrect and Q55, then clicked Key version 2. view, subject, question and filter were all kept and score_version=gv2 was added. Exactly one GET was made (?score_version=gv2), the score changed from 100 to 120, the solution text showed the gv2 version, and only one question with its matching solution was shown. 'Back to My Tests' (returnTo) was kept. Clicking Original reverted the score and history Back restored gv2. Solution-open was not posted again after a version change. (d) The 'Matched to this frozen version' badge is now 11px, sentence case, dark green on pale green, and fits inside 390px. REGRESSION CHECKS PASS: switching subject or filter selects the first match. On a has_touch mobile context, real CDP touch swipes scroll the Chemistry rail to its end (scrollLeft 974/974), and tapping Q50 opens only Q50 with its solution. Keyboard: Tab across the filters shows a 3px solid focus outline and Enter applies the filter. ArrowLeft on the Results tabs moves to Rank and activates it. Results stays forced light (html.dark.exam-light) when dark mode is preferred. PLAYER (75Q JEE fixture, both widths): the local logo /brand/jeelive-logo.webp loads (natural width 980; displayed 145x54 on desktop, 100x42 on mobile), the timer counts down, 4 options and the navigator render, and there is no page overflow. Clicking an option sends a PUT (mocked) and shows 'All responses saved'. Mark for review, Next, Previous, navigator jumps (Q30 desktop; Q75 mobile through the toggle) and the selected-option state all work. All POSTs/PUTs were intercepted. CHAPTER CHOOSER: 3 subject cards (blue, green, red), clicking Chemistry opens a list of 3 rows (Available, In progress, Completed), and the Start, Resume (opens the mocked Player) and Results links all route correctly. MY TESTS: populated In progress (1), Saved (1) and Completed (2: Completed and Time expired, with scores) tabs work in light and dark at 390px, and selecting 2 attempts enables the compare button (compare was not clicked). Hub and series pages: tab colours are correct in light and dark at both widths with no overflow. The series schedule, history and streak data were NOT mocked (they returned 404), so the series page shows error shells and its content is unverified. PRODUCTION BUILD: craco build into /tmp/build126 compiles in 31s with only exhaustive-deps warnings (SavePaperButton, SeriesStreak, LiveSeries, Player, Profile). The production bundle has no data-ve-dynamic wrappers. NEW ISSUE FOUND: in preview, the Player question navigator shows no answered, current, marked or visited state. It has the same root cause as the iteration 125 filter bug (.number-grid > button rules plus span[data-ve-dynamic] display:contents wrappers).

ui_bugs.issue: In preview, answered, current, marked and visited buttons all look the same: transparent background, 0px border, dark text. The classes are present (for example 'current marked visited' and 'answered'), but App.css:2251/2261/5997/6002 use '.number-grid > button.answered' etc. Each Button sits inside a <span data-ve-dynamic style=display:contents> wrapper, so the child combinator never matches. The production bundle has no wrappers, so it is probably fine there. Students in preview cannot see which questions they have answered or marked. The legend swatches are also tiny (9px text).

issues: The outcome Badge in .review-question-toggle shows the raw lowercase value ('skipped', 'incorrect') at 9px on desktop and 7px on mobile (App.css:2852, 5149). It is hard to read next to the new 11px Matched badge.
My Tests: 'In progress' and 'Saved papers' sit next to each other and are both amber.
Series: 'My results' and 'My analytics' sit next to each other and are both cyan.
Marked and skipped filters are both amber, and dropped and bonus are both slate. This is acceptable but makes them less distinct.
The disabled (currently selected) version button only looks pale, so it is not obvious which version is active. Consider aria-pressed with a solid style.

action_items: Replace '.number-grid > button…' (and '.editor-number-grid > button') child combinators with descendant selectors or explicit data attributes so the Player navigator states show in preview, in the same way the iteration 125 fix was done.
Optional: raise the Solutions outcome badge to 11px with sentence-case labels.
Optional: give the adjacent tabs that share a colour different accents (progress/saved, results/analytics).
critical_code_review_comments: Several other '> child' rules on mapped lists may hit the same preview wrapper issue (.result-destinations>button, .review-question-toggle > span:nth-child, .mobile-links > a.active, .streak-stats>div). Audit them.
Results.js: switching away from Solutions (e.g. to Rank) keeps subject, question and filter in the URL. This is harmless but leaves noisy URLs.
The production build still has 7 react-hooks/exhaustive-deps warnings (Player.js lines 68-69 and Profile.js line 29 are the most risky for stale state).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% of targeted checks passed; 1 new medium preview-only navigator styling bug

test_credentials: Read /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Credentials were not used; the session was fake and script-only.
seed_data_creation: None. All data came from the in-browser fixture; the customer DB was not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Load the fixture with: ns={}; exec(open('/app/tests/frontend_iter126_fixture.py').read(), ns); log=await ns['install'](page). It mocks att1 results (75Q JEE with a gv2 grade version, score 100 vs 120), play1 active attempt, the exam-navigation catalogue (chapters and mocks), and /my/tests. Subject testids are lowercase (solution-subject-mathematics) and question testids are numbers (solution-question-55). Results tabs use result-view-{value}. The result fixture needs rules, count etc. or Results crashes. The series endpoints are not mocked yet. Touch swipe works using new_context(has_touch=True) plus CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent.
rca of the issue: Player navigator: the Emergent visual-edits dev Babel plugin wraps mapped JSX children in <span data-ve-dynamic style='display:contents'>. CSS child combinators '.number-grid > button.X' therefore never match in preview. Reproduce: open /attempts/:id in preview, answer Q1 and inspect player-question-nav-1. It has class 'answered', a transparent background, and parentElement is SPAN[data-ve-dynamic]. Fix: use '.number-grid button.answered' (descendant) or explicit data-state attributes.
